$comment: Data-source settings used by scripts/fetch-sheets.mjs (runs inside GitHub Actions). Nothing here is secret. The service-account key must ONLY live in the GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON GitHub secret.
$comment_excludeColumns: Columns that are NEVER written to the published data.json. GitHub Pages sites are public, so seller credentials must never be published. Add personal data columns (e.g. "Phone Number (KAM)", "Mail (KAM)", "Email Address") here if the site should not expose them.
$comment_dateColumns: Columns whose Google Sheets date serial numbers are converted to ISO dates. Any header containing 'date' or 'timestamp' is also treated as a date column automatically.
$comment_expectedWorkColumns: Used to locate the header row and to report missing columns. Missing columns are reported as warnings, never invented.
